_comment: Single source of truth for the site chrome (header app tabs, footer, 'Guides & help', breadcrumbs, 'More apps' strip) and the /apps.html hub. Order here = order of the header tabs. Guides are discovered from each app's 'pages' globs. Edit, then run: python3 tools/build_chrome.py  -- see tools/README.md. Every piece of copy here must already appear on the app's own page; do not invent claims.

site.hub_description: All our apps in one place: B2Gaudio, DriveMail Voice, Digital Decks, CommonHealth and Mandemic. What each one does, and where to get it.

apps.name: B2Gaudio
apps.summary: Turn every phone in the room into one synchronized sound system. Music, podcasts, audiobooks, and video — in sync over WiFi.
apps.guides_intro: Ways people use B2Gaudio, step by step.
guides: Play music on multiple phones at once
Watch a movie together on a plane
Use phones as one party speaker
Audiobooks and podcasts together on a road trip

apps.name: DriveMail Voice
apps.summary: The hands-free email app for drivers. DriveMail Voice reads your unread emails aloud, lets you reply by voice, and works with Apple CarPlay.
apps.guides_intro: Straight answers about email, CarPlay, and hands-free driving.

apps.name: Digital Decks
apps.tagline: Scan it. Collect it. Build a real deck.
apps.summary: Point your camera at a Pokémon card and see what it is, how rare it is, and roughly what it's worth. Then build real decks from the cards you own. No ads, no accounts.
apps.guides_intro: Help for young collectors and the grown-ups helping them.
guides: What is my Pokémon card worth?
Build a deck from cards you own

apps.name: CommonHealth
apps.tagline: Appeal a denied medical claim — entirely on your iPhone.
apps.summary: CommonHealth reads your denial letter, finds the rule that actually applies, and writes the appeal for you to review and send. Your records never leave your phone.

apps.name: Mandemic
apps.tagline: Your group chat called. It wants an actual plan.
apps.summary: A free, platonic app for finding guys near you who actually want to do stuff: pickleball at 7, a tee time Saturday, a show on a Thursday. Not a dating app. Not social media.
